RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the July 13, 2004/Asadha 22, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation;  Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—20
Report on Cessna aircraft crash
*101. SHRIMATI. N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Directorate General of
Civil Aviation has completed its probe into
the recent crash of Cessna aircraft in which
actress Ms. Soundarya was killed;
(b) if so, whether the DGCA has
submitted its report;
(c) if so, what is the outcome of the
report; and
(d) what action Government have taken
or propose to take against the culprits?
Development of Khajuraho Airport
†*102. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that land is being
acquired free of cost from the Government
of Madhya Pradesh for the development
of Khajuraho Airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of land acquired so far
and the present status of development work
thereon; and
(d) by when, it will be completed?
Permission to Jet Airways for overseas
landing
*103. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Jet Airways are
contemplating to obtain landing slots at
various international airports including
London, Singapore and Malaysia;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof
along with the names of countries/airports
approached for securing landing slots during
the last one year;
(c) whether Government have given
permission to Jet Airways for obtaining
such landing slots; and
(d) if not, the action taken so far or
proposed to be taken against the airline?†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

LPG bottling plants
*104. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of LPG bottling plants
functioning at present in the country,
State-wise;
(b) the details of proposed LPG bottling
plants during 2004-05, State-wise/location-
wise; and
(c) the details of steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
Missing of Gold bars from Palam
Airport, New Delhi
*105. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 25 kg. Gold
bars belonging to State Bank of India which
were booked on I.C. flight No. 658 on
May 7, 2004 from Mumbai Airport were
found missing from the Palam Airport, New
Delhi after the parcel was off loaded
alongwith other parcels;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the said gold bars have been
traced; and
(d) if not, what action Government have
taken against the concerned officials?
Review of National Water Policy
*106. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to comprehensively review
the project of inter-linking of rivers in its
totality;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government propose to review the
National Water Policy;
(c) if so, the details of areas which
Government are thinking to review; and
(d) what are the reasons for such a
review?
Exploration of oil and gas in Bihar
†*107. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether drilling and other exploration
works have been undertaken to find out
petroleum and natural gas in Bihar;
(b) if so, the details and results thereof;
and
(c) the details of future plans in this
direction?
Introduction of VAT
†*108. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to introduce VAT (Value Added Tax) in
place of professional tax or sales tax;
(b) if so, the detailed outline thereof;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

constituted a Committee of Finance
Ministers of States to review the said tax;
(d) if so, the recommendations of the
said Committee;
(e) whether he is aware of the fact that
a number of State Governments have
registered protest against the said Value
Added Tax; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
LNG terminal at Kochi
*109. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal for an
LNG terminal at Kochi;
(b) if so, the present status of the
project;
(c) the names of the companies included
in the consortium;
(d) whether NTPC has agreed to be the
potential customer; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the July 13, 2004/Asadha 22, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—68
Expansion of runway at Mangalore
airport
234. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the expansion of runway of
Bajpe Airport at Mangalore has been taken
up;
(b) if so, what is the present status of
the work;
(c) by when it will be completed; and
(d) whether there is any proposal to
operate international flights once the
runway and expansion works are
completed?
Review of open sky policy
235. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have reviewed
the open sky policy, especially the
provisions relating to bilateral landing rights
being granted to various foreign airlines;
and
(b) if so, the results thereof and the fresh
guidelines proposed, if any, in this regard?
Financial performance of IA
236. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines has incurred a loss of Rs. 93 crores
in the first six months of this financial year;
(b) if so, whether the loss is expected to
increase in the second half of this year;
(c) what are the reasons for the high
losses of Indian Airlines this year;
(d) whether Indian Airlines is taking any
steps to reduce its losses; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Modernisation of Babatpur airport
†237. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
scheme to beautify and provide
afforestation at Babatpur airport in Uttar
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether funds have been provided
for the said purpose;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

57
\\SERVER3\994RS QLWRITTEN 13 JULY EV RAW TEXT\994RS 57
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) by when beautification and
afforestation is likely to be completed?
Concessional schemes of Indian
Airlines
238. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines has attracted
more passengers after the announcement
of concessional fare schemes of travel
between various cities;
(b) if so, the details thereof for the last
two months;
(c) whether Indian Airlines has any
proposal to announce more such schemes;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what other commercial strategies do
Indian Airlines have to get better seat
occupation in its planes?
International airport status to Nagpur
airport
†239. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
Government's consideration to accord
international airport status to Nagpur
airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when a decision is likely to be
taken in this regard?
Expansion and upgradation of air
strips in Uttaranchal
†240. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the num ber of air strips in
Uttaranchal and the number out of them,
being used for regular flights;
(b) whether the State Government has
sought assistance from the Central
Government for their expansion and
upgradation; and
(c) if so, the details of the assistance
being provided by the Central Government
in this regard?
Modernization of Delhi and Mumbai
airports
241. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any fresh initiatives have
been taken recently to speed up the process
of upgradation and modernization of Delhi
and Mumbai airports; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the phased time-bound programmes drawn
up for completion of the projects?
Fleet acquisition plans for
AI and IA
242. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have reviewed
the fleet acquisition plans of the Indian
Airlines and Air India; and
(b) if so, the results thereof and the fresh
programme drawn up, if any, for fleet
acquisition with a view to improving the
competitive edge of the two airlines for
their short and long-haul routes?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Consumer-oriented  Civil Aviation
Policy
243. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
considered the question of laying down a
consumer-oriented Civil Aviation Policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken and being taken in
the light of the new policy to make Civil
Aviation services more consumer-oriented?
Private participation in airport
modernization

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
